overview.description: The Climate Global - Climate Resilient REIT Index ETF (CLIM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund tracks an index of US REITs identified to have lower degree of exposure to climate events and risks.The fund selects and weights REITs by combining market cap and a scoring model used by global insurers and reinsurers.   CLIM was launched on Mar 11, 2026 and is issued by Climate Global.
